policy_rules.fixed: Read relevance ranking to budget or exhaustion.
policy_rules.first_hit: Stop fixed acquisition after the first non-insufficient base verdict.
policy_rules.challenge: After three reads or initial exhaustion, perform one secondary search if budget remains. Use focus when provisionally insufficient, otherwise challenge. Consume unseen secondary candidates then unseen initial candidates.
policy_rules.guarded: Use challenge acquisition and abstain if any single-source withdrawal changes the base verdict.

calibration.train_exclusions: Exclude all training claims sharing a cited document with any dev claim.
calibration.freeze: Commit the chosen threshold and selection artifact before computing held-out quality.

evaluation.coverage: Final verdict other than ABSTAIN, including INSUFFICIENT.
evaluation.risk: Conditional error over covered rows, null when zero covered.
evaluation.macro_f1: Unweighted mean over frozen gold classes. Undefined class F1 is zero. Extra verdicts are errors.
evaluation.evidence: Micro-recall of positive annotated sentence IDs whose entire non-whitespace sentence text is retained in scored spans. A truncated prefix with missing non-whitespace text does not count. Complete rationale rate is the fraction of eligible queries retaining every sentence of at least one positive rationale. Climate positives are individual annotated candidates.
evaluation.quote_integrity: Fraction of retained scored spans bound to the exact source slice. This checks literal identity.

uncertainty.generator: NumPy PCG64 default_rng; integers over lexicographically sorted group IDs; sample the number of distinct groups with replacement; retain every row for each selected group with multiplicity
uncertainty.interval: 95% percentile, linear interpolation; omit draws with an undefined conditional risk and report their count
uncertainty.pairing: same resamples for every policy, budget and difference within a dataset

evaluation.demo: First 40 dev query IDs ordered by SHA256 of the UTF-8 original ID, ascending.
evaluation.release_failure: Any failed, missing or duplicate run invalidates the release. Transient attempts capped at three. Complete denominator required.
